text: 你见多识广，知道那两名男子腰间藏着手枪。他们究竟需要带枪做什么，你无从得知；不过他们藏匿武器、行迹可疑，让你觉得肯定没好事。
你转身离开前，似乎还瞥见年轻男子外套褶皱下闪过一抹金属光。他或许也带着武器。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 28
text: You are well-traveled enough to know that the two men are concealing handguns at their waists. What they could possibly need them for is beyond you, but their hidden weapons and shady nature make you think it isn’t good.
Before you turn to go, you think you catch a glint of metal from beneath the folds of the young man’s coat as well. This man might likewise be armed.
